## Why This Is Asked

Tests real-world ability to design secure, scalable streaming pipelines with strict data governance. Evaluates CMEK-based tenant isolation, per-tenant IAM, VPC boundaries, cross-region DR, and practical testing.

## Key Concepts

- Pub/Sub streaming ingestion
- Dataflow (Beam) with schema validation and PII redaction

- BigQuery per-tenant datasets

- VPC Service Controls and Cloud Logging sinks
- Idempotent upserts and cross-region replication
- Cost controls and observability

## Code Example

```python
# Pseudocode: Dataflow pipeline skeleton
import apache_beam as beam
class RedactPII(beam.DoFn):
    def process(self, element):
        # redact/tokenize PII fields
        return element
with beam.Pipeline(...) as p:
    (p
     | beam.io.ReadFromPubSub(...) 
     | beam.Map(lambda x: json.loads(x))
     | beam.ParDo(RedactPII())
     | beam.io.WriteToBigQuery(..., created_dataset='tenant_dataset', write_disposition=WRITE_APPEND))
```
